clip.quote: If you're feeling off track, disconnected, like your head is barely above water, you don't need another productivity hack. You need to return to the fundamentals that made you effective before success made you reactive.
clip.why_clipworthy: This quote challenges the common belief that more productivity tools are the answer to feeling overwhelmed.
